MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.GT_FCSV_RESULTS_MST A
    USING ( SELECT V_DIVISION_ID, V_PROJECT_CODE, V_SCM_SITE_ID, V_PLANT_SITE_ID, V_ITEM_ID, V_YYYYMMDD, V_DOM_EXP, V_FCST_TYPE, V_INCOTERMS, MAX(V_CURRENCY) AS MAX_VAL
              FROM SCM_MGR.GT_FCSV_RESULTS_MST
             WHERE V_MEASURE = 'LOC'
             GROUP BY V_DIVISION_ID, V_PROJECT_CODE, V_SCM_SITE_ID, V_PLANT_SITE_ID, V_ITEM_ID, V_YYYYMMDD, V_DOM_EXP, V_FCST_TYPE, V_INCOTERMS ) B
       ON ( B.V_DIVISION_ID = A.V_DIVISION_ID
          AND B.V_PROJECT_CODE = A.V_PROJECT_CODE
          AND B.V_SCM_SITE_ID = A.V_SCM_SITE_ID
          AND B.V_PLANT_SITE_ID = A.V_PLANT_SITE_ID
          AND B.V_ITEM_ID = A.V_ITEM_ID
          AND B.V_YYYYMMDD = A.V_YYYYMMDD
          AND B.V_DOM_EXP = A.V_DOM_EXP
          AND B.V_FCST_TYPE = A.V_FCST_TYPE
          AND B.V_INCOTERMS = A.V_INCOTERMS
          AND A.V_MEASURE <> 'LOC' )
     WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.V_CURRENCY = B.MAX_VAL
      WHERE B.MAX_VAL <> A.V_CURRENCY;

        SELECT L.V_ACTIVE_FLAG, L.V_DIVISION_ID, L.V_PROJECT_CODE, L.V_SCM_SITE_ID, L.V_PLANT_SITE_ID, L.V_ITEM_ID, L.V_YYYYMMDD, L.V_CURRENCY, 'KRW', L.V_DOM_EXP, L.V_FCST_TYPE, L.V_INCOTERMS
             , CASE WHEN L.V_CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN L.V_PRICE ELSE ROUND(L.V_PRICE * NVL(RK.EXCHANGE_PRICE, 0), 3) END
             , L.V_CREATED_BY, L.V_CREATION_DATE, L.V_LAST_UPDATED_BY, L.V_ROWNUM
          FROM SCM_MGR.GT_FCSV_RESULTS_MST L
          LEFT JOIN DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE RK ON RK.DIVISION_ID = L.V_DIVISION_ID AND RK.YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(L.V_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01' AND RK.CURRENCY = 'KRW' AND RK.UNIT_CURRENCY = L.V_CURRENCY

                                AND DECODE(K.V_PROJECT_CODE, L.V_PROJECT_CODE, 1, 0) = 1

                                AND DECODE(K.V_CURRENCY, L.V_CURRENCY, 1, 0) = 1
                                AND DECODE(K.V_DOM_EXP, L.V_DOM_EXP, 1, 0) = 1
                                AND DECODE(K.V_FCST_TYPE, L.V_FCST_TYPE, 1, 0) = 1
